visualCharacteristics: Single collapsible small-print panel (closed by default, +/- toggle) titled Footnotes and Disclaimers; small gray body text with paragraphs and a numbered footnote list containing links.
contentPattern: row 1: title (e.g. Footnotes and Disclaimers); row 2: body - disclaimer paragraphs and/or an ordered list of footnote items (may contain links)
